home.heroTitle: Shaka umuduka wo hafi. Hura mu bwizerane.
home.heroSubtitle: CityRide ifasha abakiriya kuvumbura abatwara moto bemejwe bakwegereye no guhuza nabo binyuze muri porogaramu yoroshye ishingiye ku hantu uherereye.
home.sectionWhatBody: CityRide ni urubuga rwa telefone ruhuza abakiriya n'abatwara moto bo hafi yabo. Fungura porogaramu, CityRide ikakwereka abatwara moto bahari bakwegereye kugira ngo ubashe kubavugisha.
home.sectionDiscoveryBody: Ukoresheje aho uherereye, porogaramu igaragaza abatwara moto bemejwe bakwegereye, hamwe n'intera hagati yanyu n'amakuru y'umwirondoro wabo, kugira ngo uhitemo uwo guhamagara.
home.forClientsBody: Vumbura abatwara moto bakwegereye, reba umwirondoro wabo n'intera, hanyuma ubahamagare uva muri porogaramu.
home.forRidersBody: Injira muri CityRide, urangize igenzura, wifungure (online), utangire kubona abakiriya bakwegereye.
home.downloadBody: CityRide ikorera cyane cyane kuri telefone. Kuramo porogaramu kugira ngo uvumbure abatwara moto bakwegereye cyangwa winjire nk'umutwara moto wemejwe.

howItWorks.title: Uko CityRide Ikora
howItWorks.subtitle: Inzira yoroshye kandi isobanutse guhera ku kuvumbura kugeza ku irangira ry'urugendo.
clientFlowSteps: Aho aherereye harakoreshwa kugira ngo hamenyekane
howItWorks.contactEventTitle: Guhamagara (Contact Event) na Gusaba Urugendo (Trip Request)
howItWorks.contactEventBody: Guhamagara umutwara moto bikora 'Contact Event', ni ukuvuga byandika ko umukiriya yagerageje kuvugana n'uwo mutwara moto. Ntibisobanura ko urugendo rwarangiye.
howItWorks.note: Iyi tandukaniro ni ingenzi mu buryo CityRide ikora: 'Contact Event' yandika ko hari uwagerageje kuvugana, mu gihe 'Trip Request' ikurikiza inzira yayo yihariye kuva mu gusaba kugeza mu irangira.

forClients.title: Ku Bakiriya
forClients.subtitle: Ibyo umukiriya ashobora gukora muri porogaramu ya CityRide.
capabilities: Gukoresha kuvumbura abatwara moto ushingiye ku hantu uherereye
Kureba intera ku mutwara moto wese
Kureba amanota (rating) y'umutwara moto aho aboneka
Kugira uruhare mu nzira ya Trip Request
Kureba amakuru arebana n'urugendo n'ubwishyu muri porogaramu
forClients.note: Urubuga rwa CityRide rusobanura gusa ibikorwa bibaho koko muri sisitemu.

forRiders.title: Ku Batwara Moto
forRiders.subtitle: Uko winjira muri CityRide ukanakora nk'umutwara moto wemejwe.
steps: Ohereza inyandiko z'indangamuntu n'uruhushya rwo gutwara
Shyiraho ko uri online cyangwa offline
Sangira aho uherereye igihe uri online
Gira uruhare mu nzira ya Trip Request
forRiders.verificationNote: Igenzura ry'abatwara moto rikorwa binyuze muri sisitemu ya CityRide kandi rigasuzumwa n'abayobozi mu Kibaho cy'Ubuyobozi.
forRiders.cta: Tangira kwiyandikisha muri porogaramu ya CityRide

trust.title: Icyizere n'Igenzura
trust.subtitle: Uko CityRide igira icyizere hagati y'abakiriya n'abatwara moto.
trust.processBody: Abatwara moto batanga inyandiko zabo mu gihe cy'iyandikisha. Abayobozi barazisuzuma mu Kibaho cy'Ubuyobozi maze bakavugurura uko igenzura ry'umutwara moto rihagaze.
trust.disclaimer: CityRide yerekana icyizere binyuze mu nzira y'igenzura yavuzwe haruguru. Ntabwo dutanga ijambo ry'umutekano uzwi neza, icyemezo cya Leta, isuzuma ry'amateka rikorwa mu buryo bwikora, cyangwa ubwishingizi keretse ari ibyemejwe ku mugaragaro kandi bishyizwe mu bikorwa.

faq.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
faq.subtitle: Ibisubizo bishingiye ku buryo sisitemu ya CityRide ikora koko.

clientItems.a: CityRide ni urubuga rwa telefone rufasha abakiriya kuvumbura abatwara moto bo hafi no guhuza nabo ako kanya.
Fungura porogaramu ya CityRide wemere ko ikoresha aho uherereye. Abatwara moto bahari bakwegereye bazagaragara mu buryo bwikora.
Gukanda Hamagara bikora 'Contact Event', ni ukuvuga byandika ko wagerageje kuvugana n'uwo mutwara moto.

clientItems.q: Ese Contact Event ni kimwe n'urugendo?
clientItems.a: Oya. Contact Event yandika gusa ko wagerageje kuvugana. Urugendo rukurikiza inzira yihariye ya Trip Request.

clientItems.q: Bibaho iki nyuma yo gukora Trip Request?
clientItems.a: Trip Request inyura mu ntambwe zikurikira: Yasabwe, Yemewe cyangwa Yanzwe, Irimo gukorwa, hanyuma Yarangiye cyangwa Yahagaritswe.

clientItems.q: Bibaho iki nta mutwara moto uboneka hafi?
clientItems.a: Porogaramu izakumenyesha ko nta mutwara moto uboneka hafi kugira ngo ugerageze nyuma gato.

riderItems.q: Nabona nte kuba umutwara moto wa CityRide?
riderItems.a: Fungura konti y'umutwara moto muri porogaramu urangize iyandikisha.

riderItems.q: Ni ayahe makuru asabwa mu iyandikisha?
riderItems.a: Ugomba gutanga inyandiko y'indangamuntu, iy'uruhushya rwo gutwara, n'amakuru y'ikinyabiziga cyawe.
Abayobozi barasuzuma inyandiko wohereje mu Kibaho cy'Ubuyobozi maze bakavugurura uko igenzura ryawe rihagaze.

riderItems.q: Nabona nte gushyira status ya online cyangwa offline?
riderItems.a: Koresha akabuto ko kuba uhari muri porogaramu kugira ngo wishyire online cyangwa offline igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
Igihe uri online, porogaramu isangira aho uherereye kugira ngo abakiriya bo hafi bakubone.

download.qrBody: Skana iyi kode ya QR ukoresheje kamera ya telefone yawe kugira ngo ufungure paji yo gukurayo.
